turns.replyText:
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?

We currently don’t ship worldwide. Our shipping regions are:

Contiguous United States: all products
Alaska & Hawaii: select products
Select regions in Canada: select products, seasonally

Outside the US and Canada, we do not ship at this time.

For Canadian orders, prices are shown in CAD and already include all duties and taxes in the listed price, so you won’t get a separate customs or duty bill. For US orders, normal state/local sales tax applies at checkout, and there are no international customs charges.

If you tell me what country you’re in, I can let you know whether your specific location is within our current Canadian service area or only eligible for US shipping addresses.

turns.replyText:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Our standard shipping is set up a bit differently than “order today, ships in X days.”

Here’s how it works:

You choose the timeframe at checkout
In the delivery calendar, you pick an estimated arrival date (for US orders) based on:

Our processing time to prepare your plants, plus
The carrier’s estimated transit time to your address.

Typical transit time
Once your order actually ships, transit with our standard ground service is typically about 1–5 business days, depending on how far you are from our Oregon nurseries.

What to expect after ordering

If you use the regular checkout, you’ll see the delivery calendar and choose your date.
If you use an express payment method like Shop Pay or PayPal, the system will assign an estimated arrival date automatically, and you’ll see it in your order confirmation email.
You’ll get tracking by email as soon as your package is scanned by the carrier.

If you tell me your state or ZIP code, I can give you a more specific idea of the likely transit time to your area within that 1–5 business day range.
